title: Projects
description: Side projects built outside of work: from a subscription checkout integrated with the TapPay payment API to the job-search tracker I use every day.

billing_vault.name: BillingVault
billing_vault.tagline: A mock SaaS subscription checkout wired to the TapPay sandbox payment flow.
billing_vault.note: Sandbox environment. No real charges are made.

highlights.0: TapPay Fields tokenize card data into a Prime, so raw card numbers never reach my own server; saved cards are charged via Pay by Token.
highlights.1: Subscription requests carry an idempotency key plus a submit lock, so retries and double clicks never double charge.
highlights.2: Sessions are verified with Supabase SSR, with CSP nonces and a redirect allowlist guarding against injection and open redirects.

job_tracker.name: Job Tracker
job_tracker.tagline: The application tracker I use daily during my own job search, installable to the home screen.
job_tracker.note: A tool I use personally, so sign-up is closed. The Live Demo is a no-login trial mode whose data stays in your browser tab.

highlights.0: Built as a PWA: installable, with assets cached by a service worker.
highlights.1: A kanban board tracks every application so stalled stages stand out at a glance.
highlights.2: Born from my own job-search pain points and iterated on while using it.
